name: Dance(C:S) Solo Shorts
description: Vertical dance short of one performer from a 16:9 stage recording: the whole 9:16 frame is the source, reframed by a camera that keeps tracking the centre of the body in a full shot - head to feet, little empty space - and zooms only as far as needed to keep the whole body in. The music runs uncut. No title, captions only if asked.

layout.cropRule: No fixed crop: tools/dance_camera.py writes edit.json camera.keys from the performer's mask (isnet-anime) - every frame it moves, cuts only for camera.punch. The full shot is narrower than the stage, so stream overlays at the sides (chat) stay out.

pacing.note: A dance short is the song part the user picks, uncut: keep = [{ "s": .., "e": .., "raw": true }] so the waveform cutter never trims the music.

camera.fullShot: head to feet in frame, body centred, little empty space around
camera.basis: measured 2026-10-01 on a creator's own vertical reframe of a stream dance (private file) and 4 reference shorts - every number with its basis in tools/dance_camera.py

guidance: The camera tracks the body centre and never moves ahead of it; small sways inside a narrow band are ignored. Big or sudden changes go slowly, within the speed / acceleration / zoom-rate limits measured on a hand-made reframe - large quick moves and zooms are dizzying.

Motion leads, the camera follows or moves with it - never the camera before the motion. Zoom out only once the body actually goes past the frame, slowly, and never past 8:2 - the performer fills at least 80% of the frame. Once a back-and-forth ends, zoom back in to the tight full shot; while the body goes back and forth, widen to the range it has covered so far and do not zoom in until it ends.
A walk-off ending may be left to leave the frame - cut the keep there or let it go.

If the prompt calls it a challenge, look at several published versions of that challenge first: challenges punch in on beats (one reference: the upper body for ~4s). Put those moments in edit.json camera.punch ([{ "s": 12.0, "e": 15.8, "z": 2.0 }]) and rerun the camera tool.
Music runs through: no cuts inside the dance, no audio fades except at the two ends, no audio filters - one fixed gain to the loudness target.
If the source's audio starts later or earlier than its video (ffprobe stream start_time), body warns - beat and level times are on the video clock.
